name: Tabs
description: WAI-ARIA tab strip with arrow-key navigation and count badges.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Names the strip when several share a page.

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: v-model update with the new tab key.

example: <s-tabs v-model="tab" :tabs="[{ key: 'overview', label: 'Overview' }, { key: 'orders', label: 'Orders', count: 12 }]" />
